title.suggested: Tom Allen Leaves for Detroit to See Mace–O'Baldwin Fight

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Tom Allen, Jack Looney and a few others left St. Louis by train for Detroit to watch the expected Mace–O'Baldwin prize fight near that city.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Democrat, St. Louis, Monday, September 2, 1872

facts.fact: Allen and Jack Looney left St. Louis on the Toledo, Wabash and Western train for Detroit to attend the Mace–O'Baldwin prize fight

notes: Headline calls the fight a 'fizzle'. The current summary copies OCR errors.
